usedFor: Sangam CRM holds leads, tickets and accounts, and TestMonitor opens an issue after “Ticket Is Updated” through “Create issue”.

bestTemplate.name: “Ticket Is Updated” in Sangam CRM, then “Create issue” in TestMonitor
bestTemplate.why: A changed ticket becomes an issue with title, priority and assignee, so engineers see it.

watchOut: “Ticket Is Updated” is polling, and “Update issue” needs an existing issue, so create it first.
